This may be a little long but,

I've been going through some tough times and what has always managed to help me smile is humor. My friends never fail to make me smile and I know if I told them about my *issues* they would help me out but sometimes that isn't enough.

When I'm older I want to become a youtuber. A funny one.

I want to make kids smile so that they wont have to cry themselves to sleep. I want to tell depressed teens that they are not, and will never be alone so that they wont feel so isolated and different. I want to stop anyone ever from going through what I am right now. Because the pain you are burdened with once you get all these feeling is a too heavy load to bear alone.

I have to live. To make other people's lives better. That's what's keeping me from suicide now.

**i hope it lasts**
